answer: In a decentralized network, each AI agent must prove its identity through a unique identifier, akin to a digital quartz. To resist Sybil attacks, nodes are required to stake a portion of their computational power, forming a tide of authentication. This mechanism ensures that a rogue entity cannot easily create multiple false identities by mimicking legitimate nodes. Attacking this system would cost an imposter significant computational resources, similar to trying to move a grove of trees by themselves.
